 "c24_receipt":"eval-log/run-dev-graph-system-spec-c24-receipt.json","created_at":now},ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+"\n",encoding="utf-8")
rec = json.loads((el/"run-dev-graph-system-spec-c24-receipt.json").read_text())
def sha(p): return hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
inputs = {str(p.relative_to(root)): sha(p) for p in sorted((root/"system-spec").rglob("*")) if p.is_file()}
pj = json.loads((root/"plugins/system-spec-harness/.claude-plugin/plugin.json").read_text())

comp = (root/"plugins/dev-graph/plugin-composition.yaml").read_text()
rng = re.search(r'system-spec-harness:\n\s+version: "([^"]+)"', comp).group(1)
v = tuple(int(x) for x in pj["version"].split("."))
in_range = (0,1,22) <= v < (1,0,0)
report = {
 "report":"run-dev-graph-system-spec preflight (pre-choice minimal artifact)","generated_at":now,
 "R0_context":{"c24_receipt":"eval-log/run-dev-graph-system-spec-c24-receipt.json","c24_receipt_sha256":sha(el/"run-dev-graph-system-spec-c24-receipt.json"),

   "system_spec_realpath":str((root/"system-spec").resolve()),"system_spec_is_symlink":(root/"system-spec").is_symlink(),
   "system_spec_inside_repo":str((root/"system-spec").resolve()).startswith(rec["repo_root"]+"/"),
   "repository_id":rec["repository_id"],"git_common_dir":rec["git_common_dir"],"worktree_id":rec["worktree_id"],
   "lineage_gate":{"command":"plugins/dev-graph/scripts/validate-source-lineage.py --repo-root <repo_root> --graph .dev-graph/state/graph.json","exit_code":0,"status":"pass","checked":0,"violations":[]},
   "resume_decision":"new_creation (checked=0)"},
 "R1_preflight":{"plugin_manifest":"plugins/system-spec-harness/.claude-plugin/plugin.json","name":pj["name"],"version":pj["version"],
   "composition_range":rng,"composition_source":"plugins/dev-graph/plugin-composition.yaml#external_dependencies.system-spec-harness.version","version_in_range":in_range,
   "required_entry_points":{e:{"declared":e in pc["entry_points"]["skills"],"skill_md_exists":(root/f"plugins/system-spec-harness/skills/{e}/SKILL.md").is_file()} for e in req}},
 "inputs":inputs,
 "verdict":"PASS" if in_range and all(e in pc["entry_points"]["skills"] for e in req) else "FAIL"}
(el/"run-dev-graph-system-spec-preflight-report.json").write_text(json.dumps(report,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+"\n",encoding="utf-8")
print(report["verdict"], h)
PY
P=eval-log/run-dev-graph-system-spec-preflight-report.json; echo "path: $CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/$P"; shasum -a 256 "$P"; echo "開き方: less $CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/$P"
